# RunnerActedEventArgs.IsDecidedHere property

Whether this game decides it: the runner is played from this game. Each other game sees it in its own simulation of the runner, which follows the runner's game closely but can differ: a jump or a landing a frame apart, or a stumble it saw and the runner's game did not.
